negative_check.method: After drafting: searched UAP/AARO disclosure, Pasco County and New Port Richey news, and JPMorgan; compared the candidate list against every front swept and X US trends (GTA VI, APEC, Shenzhen, Xi Jinping trends match the Shenzhen lead; others are sports/entertainment).
negative_check.result: No new government UAP release found since the Oct 23 PURSUE tranche. JPMorgan: AI-agent FX payments test with Hyundai Card and CFO succession (Also noted). Pasco: sheriff's copycat-site warning (Also noted); Amendment 3 fire-fee study (lead).
